model.title: Finger Lakes National Heritage Area Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand (D-NY)

summary.text: The bill would establish the Finger Lakes region in New York as an official National Heritage Area, adding it to the federal National Heritage Area System. This designation would recognize the area's historical, cultural, and natural significance while allowing for coordinated preservation and tourism efforts in the region.
